info.title: AI Growth OS — Public & Management API
info.description: Baseline API contract for Week 1 (M01-M03, Pilot Lead Form, Health & Operations) and First Slice Workflow/Ledger Contracts (Task, Artifact, Approval). Owner: Thiệu Quang (BE Core & Contracts Lead).

BearerAuth.description: User bearer token. Membership and permissions are derived on the server.

title.example: Expat Housing in Da Nang Guide

objective.example: Generate qualified expat leads for Da Nang housing

Forbidden.description: Action not allowed for user role or tenant

get.summary: List workspaces the authenticated user belongs to

post.summary: Create a new workspace (creator automatically becomes Owner)

get.summary: List sources in workspace with status filter

post.summary: Upload or register a new source metadata
Approve or reject a source version (Owner only)
Enqueue a new workflow task (Owner or Editor)

422.description: Invalid task definition or missing dependencies

get.summary: Get workflow task status and details

post.summary: Create or register a content artifact (Idempotent replay supported)
Submit a Growth Lead campaign plan artifact for transactional acceptance and DAG enqueue

201.description: Campaign plan accepted and DAG root task queued

200.description: Idempotent replay of previously accepted plan

422.description: Validation failed or circular dependency detected

post.summary: Approve Growth Lead learning artifact and enqueue next-iteration research task
post.description: Requires active workspace owner. Validates bounded iteration (<= 3), aggregate inputs, hash provenance, and transactionally enqueues deduplicated research.run task with approval ledger entry.

403.description: Permission denied - only workspace owner can approve learning tasks

422.description: Validation failed, stale context, or invalid iteration/quota bounds

get.summary: Get specific artifact details and evidence
List approval records and audit log

post.summary: Review approval target with OCC version and hash check (Owner only)

409.description: Version or hash mismatch (stale review conflict)

post.summary: Submit lead form on TripC public website (Idempotent)

422.description: Validation error (invalid email or missing consent)

get.summary: List leads in workspace (sales handoff & pipeline)
Get workspace lead detail by ID

404.description: Lead not found in this workspace

patch.summary: Update lead status, sales owner, or advisory notes

post.summary: Authorize and execute an external tool/connector through the Security Gateway

403.description: Role unauthorized, approval not granted, or ads mutation forbidden

409.description: Version or hash mismatch with approval

get.summary: List audit logs of tool executions and denials in workspace

200.description: List of tool execution audit entries

get.summary: Get workspace report with real metrics snapshot and missing reasons
List system and business exceptions in workspace with owners

post.summary: Create a new system exception with assigned owner

patch.summary: Update exception status, assigned owner, or resolution note

post.summary: Record outbox event with deduplication key for agent consistency

get.summary: List outbox events (safe & idempotent according to RFC 9110)
